nieuw.tekst: Ideally, the screening unit should advance at the same speed as the unit it protects, so the protected unit does not lose time moving forward.
nieuw.waarom: He says this maximises the time the screen can absorb fire while the units behind it advance.

nieuw.titel: Use woods to block shooting and charging lanes
nieuw.tekst: Use woods to block line of sight completely, rather than merely reduce the visible portion of a unit. Move behind the woods to avoid attacks, with the option of coming back through to shoot or contest a quarter.
nieuw.voorbeeld: He describes a lone Glade Rider using a crescent-shaped wood to hide on the far side or return through it to shoot or contest a quarter in Domination.

nieuw.titel: Hide mobile survivors when nothing remains to win
nieuw.tekst: Once there is nothing else to win on the battlefield, move mobile survivors out to the wings and hide behind terrain to save their points. He particularly recommends this endgame avoidance for elves in tournament play.
nieuw.waarom: He says that on a nearly empty board, units with 360-degree movement can move faster than their pursuers and avoid being caught. In his view, seeking cover in the endgame can win games.
nieuw.voorbeeld: After four Glade Riders were killed, the surviving model stayed outside charge arcs and eventually hid behind a forest, saving the unit's points.
